integrity: The proof establishes the weighted-forest rank identity by leaf elimination, converts support counts to character counts using the published Kirillov-rank theorem, and derives the rooted matching-support recursion directly. A standalone checker exhaustively verifies matrix ranks, support counts, the recursion, and the character degree-squared identity in representative trees.
scientific_limitations: The graphical-group character formula is stated for odd finite fields.
The rooted recurrence is an exact recursive formula rather than a single closed product for arbitrary tree shape.
The forest rank argument does not extend unchanged to cyclic supports, where Pfaffian cancellations can occur.
title: Tree graphical groups have matching-support character polynomials
